2: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
3: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah.
4: But know that the Lord has set apart for himself him who is godly: The Lord will hear when I call to him.
5: When agitated, do not sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
6: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the Lord.
7: Many say, "Who will show us any good?" Lord, let the light of your face shine on us.
8: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
9: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, the Lord alone, make me live in safety.
